claim.quote: We report on the results at ADONE to study the properties of the newly found 3.1-BeV particle.

name: Preliminary Result of Frascati (ADONE) on the Nature of a New 3.1-GeV Particle Produced in e+e- Annihilation
notes: The abstract page says '3.1-BeV' (the 1974 unit). The paper is signed by three groups; the Gamma-Gamma Group is attributed to Gamma-Gamma 2 (second-generation), see the experiment record.
key_value_text is null: the abstract states no numerical value.
The paper is a preliminary result; the result type is 'measurement'.

summary.plain: Three ADONE groups reported a first study of the properties of the 3.1 GeV particle discovered days earlier at SLAC and Brookhaven. ADONE's energy was pushed just beyond its design value to see the resonance, one of the first confirmations of the J/psi.
summary.technical: Gamma-Gamma, MEA and Baryon-Antibaryon groups at ADONE: study of the properties of the newly found 3.1 GeV particle (J/psi) in e⁺e⁻ annihilation after the machine was pushed beyond its standard 3.0 GeV, Phys. Rev. Lett. 33, 1408 (received 18 November 1974); an erratum is Phys. Rev. Lett. 33, 1649.

title: Preliminary Result of Frascati (ADONE) on the Nature of a New 3.1-GeV Particle Produced in e+e- Annihilation
why_it_matters: The INFN-LNF page says the second-generation detectors at ADONE gave significant contributions to the measurement of the new particle's properties, and that ADONE could reach the energy only by pushing the machine beyond its standard parameters.
